Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 27 now!
Synopsis :
Chandragupta does not inform Chandragupta about the incident when Mura insulted Dhananand by piercing a thorn in his leg. Chanakya assigns a difficult task to Chandragupta. Despite his unwillingness, Chandragupta is bound to finish the assigned task. Sthoolbhadra and his friends decide to help Chandragupta but are stopped by Chanakya. He reveals to Chandragupta's friends about his real intentions behind the assigned task. Elsewhere, Mura follows Dhananand's instructions and cleans the premises of the palace of the Magadha kingdom.
